actions.body: Dear Mr Vale, we are following up on the rat activity at 14 Mosswold Crescent, Brindlewick. On 18 August we recorded that you would arrange the works directly, and we asked for an expected completion date and confirmation when complete. We have not had that. The tenant reports that pest control made what they understood to be a final visit on 7 September, but that the contractors expected to fill or work on the openings did not attend on 8 September, and the openings are still unsealed. Please could you tell us: (1) who your contractor is and what work is planned (the under-sink openings, the wall area or the external drain openings), (2) the date it will be done, and (3) whether you can share any pest-control report. If you would rather Northbridge Lettings arrange an inspection, please say so. We cannot instruct anyone without your written approval. Kind regards, Tara Wren, Northbridge Lettings
